records.description_rewritten: Barnett Demesne is Belfast's extensive former estate park around Malone House, with mature trees, paths and outdoor recreation. The original directory recommends walking from parking through trees, but its two actual comments date from 2018 and 2023 and offer no documented encounter. Belfast City Council confirms that this is a controlled-hours public park, not a round-the-clock venue: on 6 November 2026 opening is 07:30 with closing at 17:30, moving to 17:00 on 8 November. Old directory advice about evening visits therefore cannot be assumed compatible with park gates.
records.location_identity: Barnett Demesne council park, south Belfast by Shaw's Bridge/Malone House, Milltown Road BT9 5PB; specific wooded path in source not pinned.
records.access_conditions: City council park opens 07:30 daily and closes seasonally. 25 Oct–7 Nov 2026 close 17:30, 8–21 Nov close 17:00, 22 Nov–31 Dec close 16:30. Mountain-bike trails/children recreation subject to restrictions. No public after-gate access assumption.

records.description_rewritten: Calton Hill is a busy central Edinburgh heritage hill with skyline viewpoints and listed monuments. Two specialist directories record it as a cruising area, but the CruisingGays map/data are years old and the archived Squirt listing cannot be opened without access. There is no date-supported recent encounter. On the hill's steep western Greenside slope a conservation group has proposed further nature reserve protection during 2026; that proposal has been considered but should not be described as an already-designated new reserve. The exact alleged cruising section and legal access are unknown.
records.location_identity: Calton Hill near Waterloo Place/Regent Road, Edinburgh; landmark supported, specific spot not pinned. Source 7 Squirt candidate ref 20083.
records.access_conditions: Public hilltop viewing/heritage grounds with steep paths and protected ecological areas, tourists and monument events. Vehicle gate restrictions are separate from pedestrian access; private monument areas and wooded slopes must not be assumed open for sex meetings.

records.description_rewritten: Blackford Hill and neighbouring Hermitage of Braid form a designated Local Nature Reserve in southern Edinburgh, with Observatory Hill paths, woodland and ponds. A Gays-Cruising listing mentions footpaths starting at Observatory car park but has no user comments despite undated claims of busyness. CruisingGays and archived Squirt also index Blackford Hill, which corroborates the location's identity across directories, not any current encounter. Edinburgh City Council confirms formal public access routes, heritage and wildlife facilities. The car park, public trails and visitor centre toilets are not automatically an adult meeting area.
